key_decisions.decision: Preserves title, lasting love and direct-address transition.
Keeps I said as pinned and the building image.
Retains the unusual divine-sons designation and both occurrences of the name.
Preserves both full and short divine names and surrounding faithfulness.
Retains mythic Rahab and the slain comparison, with an explanatory note.
Follows qere passive rise and preserves their/our shift and horn.
Retains plural faithful ones in the pinned text and the divine announcement.
Chooses the creditor/oppressor sense of yashi while noting outwitting as an alternative.
Retains bestowed rank rather than suggesting biological birth order.
Preserves lunar witness imagery, noting the witness's possible distinct identity.
Keeps the sharp protest against the preceding promise.
Retains the accusation of covenant repudiation without explaining it away.
Chooses splendor for the difficult purity/brightness term with a note.
Keeps first-person mortality and the searching creation question.
Renders the compressed final clause with implied taunts from the context; marks the difficulty.
Retains footsteps rather than rewriting them as delayed messianic arrival.
Preserves the book-closing doxology and doubled amen amid unresolved lament.
